impact.text: Buybacks can be executed at arbitrarily manipulated prices, enabling extraction of value from the treasury/BuyBackBurner contract.

precondition_sources.text: At least one block has elapsed since the last cumulative price update when validatePrice() is evaluated.
A malicious actor temporarily skews the Uniswap V2 pool price (e.g., with a flash loan) around the buyback transaction.
Funds are available in the treasury/BuyBackBurner contract.

intent_sources.text: Buybacks must be protected by a TWAP-based slippage check that does not collapse to the current spot price, so that the check fails for extreme price deviations.
The oracle should compute a true TWAP from two different cumulative price observations over time rather than from a single spot price.
Swaps should set amountOutMinimum based on the oracle to avoid trading at bad spot prices even if oracle validation is bypassed.
